task: Build two as-similar-as-possible offline top-down racing games, one no-skill arm and one full-UPG arm, then run the same mechanical acceptance checks.
acceptance_checks: lap count can advance through checkpoints
reverse/forward anti-farming probe does not increment a lap
debug fields and visible HUD numbers exist
boundary probe stays inside the drivable band

diagnostic_result.task_outcome: both arms passed the frozen mechanical acceptance suite
diagnostic_result.causal_claim: none; same-family, single-scenario, non-locked pilot evidence cannot establish UPG efficacy
useful_signal: A2 produced a bounded field report with validation, cleanup, scope and feedback metadata.
A2 feedback exposed two fixable runtime usability defects: late risk-key failure and report-level/report-obligation confusion.

absorbed_improvements: task-context risk keys are now closed over canonical risk dimensions
planner output now separates report level from field-test completion-report obligation
